description: Find companies by product category, licence (licensed_in matches the home country or any passported country), licence type, authority, and agent access (has_sandbox, has_mcp, has_api), optionally min_agent_ready (1–5, the product's Agent-Ready score; available once those results are published). Returns each company with its approved products (with agent_access), LEI, licence summaries and self-reported certifications. Every licence carries source_url and last_checked_at so you can verify it on the regulator's register. From public registers as of the last-checked date. Always confirm on the regulator's register before relying on it. Use list_provider_filters for valid slugs. Ordered by company name, then slug. cursor is the next_cursor from a previous page. Unknown arguments are rejected.

has_api.description: Only companies with a product that has an API (flag, docs or OpenAPI).

has_mcp.description: Only companies with a product that has a public MCP server.

has_sandbox.description: Only companies with a product that has a sandbox.

licensed_in.description: Two-letter ISO country code; matches home or passported licences.

min_agent_ready.description: Only companies with a product whose Agent-Ready score is at least this (1–5). Available once Agent-Ready results are published.

q.description: q (or query): text matched against company and product names.

query.description: Alias of q; q wins if both are sent.

name: find_providers
title: Find fintech providers by licence and capability
